written: 2026-10-25, before any conjugation defect was paired with a spectral value (only the 1387 orbit defects were inspected)
part: Phase XII Part II: the conjugation-defect law

definitions.right_action: d.Q: every child frame factor h_c replaced by h_c Q (Q a 3x3 permutation matrix)
definitions.conjugation_defect: delta_Q(d) = number of the 8 child slots at which conj_Q(d) (phase11_frontier.conj_decoration) differs from d; delta_Q(d) = 0 iff Q stabilises d
definitions.theorem_part: Orbit Lemma (b): delta_Q(d) = 0 implies T_L(dQ) unitarily equivalent to T_L(d) for every L and E_*(dQ) = E_*(d)

data: exact Y3 of stage X3 (phase11_frontier_X3), all 280 332 S3-conjugation representatives d and the 5 non-identity Q; Y3(dQ) read at the representative of dQ

hypotheses.H0_theorem_check: delta = 0 implies |Y3(dQ) - Y3(d)| < 1e-9 for every such pair
hypotheses.H1_rank_law: Spearman rho(delta, |Y3(dQ) - Y3(d)|) >= 0.3 over the pairs with delta >= 1
hypotheses.H2_monotone_medians: the median of |Y3(dQ) - Y3(d)| is non-decreasing in delta over the delta values with at least 100 pairs

falsified_if: any of H0-H2 fails; a failure is reported as such
